releases.title: Find a date in the Igbo market calendar
releases.summary: The French market-day calculator identifies the Igbo market day for a date in Nigeria and lists the next occurrences in its four-day cycle.

releases.title: Accessible labels for invoice line items
releases.summary: New and restored invoice rows identify quantity, unit price and tax percentage for people using screen readers.

releases.title: Daily break-even estimate for POS agents
releases.summary: The POS agent calculator shows how many transactions to attempt each day to cover monthly operating costs. The estimate uses your commission terms, operating days and expected failure rate.

releases.title: French discovery and editorial refresh
releases.summary: Improved French product discovery and normalized public editorial surfaces.

releases.title: Search indexing cleanup
releases.summary: Reconciled search-facing indexability rules and stale discovery output.

releases.title: Local fee, fuel and PAYE finders
releases.summary: Added source-aware mobile-money, fuel and PAYE discovery paths for local decisions.

releases.title: Hausa utility expansion
releases.summary: Expanded verified Hausa utility coverage without claiming full locale parity.
